verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Datalab returns per-request conversion outputs in open formats (Markdown, HTML, JSON) and keeps its core models open source. Neither is a documented account-level export of all user data: stored files, pipelines, extraction schemas, or job history. Per-call outputs and self-hostable open-source models are adjacent features, not a 'take all your data and leave' capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
